stations.title: A typed number
stations.text: An average worked out once, copied by hand.

captions: Tobias asks which products are dear, and that hides a second question: dear next to what?
Today an average is worked out once and typed in. It goes stale when a price moves.
You write queries with a question inside them, in three tasks.
Now each query works its own averages out every time it runs.
Same question, no copied numbers. A new price list still works.
